uncited: **Base Plane Identification:** Identify the volume face (plane of voxels) that is most parallel and nearest to the current image plane.
**Ray Generation:** Cast rays from each pixel on the base plane into the volume dataset.
**Voxel Access:** Read and process voxels in planes parallel to the base plane.
*   **View-dependent artifacts:** Occur when switching base planes if sub-pixel ray starting locations are not supported.
*   **Memory Access:** Optimized for regular, object-order data access.
